bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a grant to Our Saviour's Community Services in the city of Minneapolis.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+OUR SAVIOUR'S COMMUNITY SERVICES; APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$5,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Our Saviour's Community Services, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to design, construct, furnish, and equip an expansion and renovation of their current facilities in the city of Minneapolis, including a new multiuse building to house 40 permanent supportive housing units, a school for immigrant adult English learners (English Learning Center), offices for staff, and a geothermal system. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a grant to Our Saviour's Community Services in the city of Minneapolis.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. OUR SAVIOUR'S COMMUNITY SERVICES; APPROPRIATION.

$5,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Our Saviour's Community Services, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to design, construct, furnish, and equip an expansion and renovation of their current facilities in the city of Minneapolis, including a new multiuse building to house 40 permanent supportive housing units, a school for immigrant adult English learners (English Learning Center), offices for staff, and a geothermal system. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.

This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.
